question: P can do 1/2 of a work in 10 days and Q can do 1/5 of the same work in 4 days. In how many days can both finish the work, working together?
solution:
Given:

P can do 1/2 of a work in 10 days and Q can do 1/5 of the same work in 4 days.

Concept used:

If A and B alone can complete a task in X and Y days respectively, then they together will take = XY/(X + Y) days to complete the work.

Calculation:

P can do the entire work in = 10 ÷ 1/2 = 20 days

Q can do the entire work in = 4 ÷ 1/5 = 20 d
ays

Now, working together, they can finish the work in = frac {20 times 20}{20 + 20} = 10 days

**∴ In 10 days, they both can finish the work working together.**
